debug_level.description: Debug log level: 0 (none) to 9 (all). Higher = more verbose.

log_stderror.description: Log to standard error instead of syslog. Set to 'yes' for containerized deployments.

mem_dump_shared.description: Dump shared memory stats on exit. Useful for debugging memory leaks.

max_fwd.description: Maximum allowed value in the Max-Forwards header. Prevents infinite loops.

stats_interval.description: Interval (seconds) between statistics dumps to the statistics module.

auth_enabled.description: Enable SIP authentication (Digest). Requires auth module and database.

listeners.description: Network interfaces and ports to listen on. Each entry includes protocol, address, and port.

db_url.description: Database connection URL. Format: driver://user:pass@host/dbname. Supported: mysql, postgres, sqlite.
